Container.Name: rockfm-enrichment
Container.Overview:
Records Spain's RockFM and replays it on a wall-clock delay, so a Madrid morning show lands on your morning. While the audio sits in the buffer it is identified by audio fingerprinting and enriched with title, artist, album, year, artwork, duration and elapsed time. Stretches that are not songs are labelled in Spanish with the real programme name and presenters.
Serves a delayed HLS stream plus a now-playing API, and can push both the audio and the corrected metadata into AzuraCast.
The station's own stream metadata is ignored: it runs hours to days behind.
NOTE: with the default six hour delay there is nothing to play for the first six hours after a fresh start. That is the buffer filling, not a fault - the dashboard shows a countdown, and the health check stays green throughout.
Everything else is configured from the dashboard rather than here, including the whole AzuraCast integration - restarting to change a setting would tear a hole in the recording and discard whatever the analyzer was part way through.

Config.Name: WebUI / HLS Port
Config.Description: Delayed HLS stream, now-playing API and web player.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Audio buffer, database and cached artwork. Around 700 MB for a 24 hour buffer.

Config.Name: Your Timezone
Config.Description: The delay is computed from this against Europe/Madrid, so the Spanish schedule lands on your clock. It follows DST on both sides automatically (6h most of the year, 5h during the weeks when Spain and the US disagree).

Config.Name: Buffer Hours
Config.Description: Hours of audio kept on disk. Must exceed the delay; 24 leaves room to rewind and to ride out an outage. Roughly 29 MB per hour.

Config.Name: Recognizer
Config.Description: shazamio (free, no key, unofficial), audd or acrcloud. The local fingerprint index handles repeat plays, so this is only consulted for audio never heard before.

Config.Name: AzuraCast DJ Codec
Config.Description: mp3 re-encodes at 192k and is the safest. copy passes the original AAC through untouched, if your harbour accepts it.
